effects: Records one For (1) or Against (0) vote on proposal _proposalId; any other value reverts.
If the signer is a registered proxy, the vote is counted for the member it acts for, not the signer's own address (_getOperatingAccount).
Marks the operating account as having voted, so it cannot vote again on this proposal. No assets move.
formats.shown: Intent 'cast vote' with the proposal id and the vote choice mapped to For/Against.

findings.title: castVote has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line leaves out the choice and the proposal.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json castVote: intent 'cast vote', no interpolatedIntent; fields #._proposalId and #._support enum voteType {0: Against, 1: For}.

findings.title: castVote: when the signer is a proxy, the vote counts for the member it acts for, and the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: PollingManagementGroup.sol castVote: address voterAccount = _getOperatingAccount(msg.sender); _storeVote(_proposalId, voterAccount, _support). proxyToVoter is read from storage.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. A label or a note could say the vote is cast for your member account, or for the member you proxy.

effects: Sends msg.value native SGB, which must equal the stored proposalFeeValueWei, to the burn address 0x...dEaD.

Creates a new proposal with the given description. The proposer is the signer, or the member the signer proxies for. Default settings come from storage: accept=true, start after votingDelaySeconds, stored period, threshold and majority.
formats.shown: Intent 'create proposal and burn fee' with the description and the native fee amount labelled as burned.

findings.title: propose has no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line leaves out the fee amount.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json propose: intent 'create proposal and burn fee', fields #._description and @.value 'Proposal fee (burned)'; case 2 shows '100 SGB'.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent 'Create proposal and burn {@.value} fee'.

findings.title: propose uses voting settings from storage and a proposer that may be the proxied member; neither can be shown.
findings.evidence: PollingManagementGroup.sol propose: proposer = _getOperatingAccount(msg.sender); settings use votingDelaySeconds, votingPeriodSeconds, thresholdConditionBIPS, majorityConditionBIPS from storage.
findings.fix: None. These values are in storage, not in calldata.

formats.key: proposeWithSettings(string _description, (bool accept, uint256 votingStartTs, uint256 votingPeriodSeconds, uint256 thresholdConditionBIPS, uint256 majorityConditionBIPS) _settings)
effects: Only the maintainer can call it. Creates a new proposal with the signer as proposer and the given description. No fee and no assets move.
Voting starts at max(now, votingStartTs) and ends votingPeriodSeconds later.

accept=true: the proposal passes only if turnout meets the threshold and For votes exceed the majority share. accept=false: the proposal passes unless turnout meets the threshold and Against votes exceed the majority share.
Every current group member becomes eligible to vote on this proposal.
formats.shown: Intent 'create proposal' with the description, a raw accept flag labelled 'Accept if vote passes', earliest start date, voting period, and threshold and majority in bps.

findings.title: proposeWithSettings: the 'Accept if vote passes' label gets the accept flag's meaning wrong; false means the proposal passes unless rejected.
findings.evidence: PollingManagementGroup.sol _proposalSucceeded: if turnout is below the threshold, return !_proposal.accept; it compares (accept ? forVotePower : againstVotePower) with majority. descriptor.json: label 'Accept if vote passes', format raw, path accept; case 3 shows 'true'.
findings.fix: Label it 'Proposal type' and map it with an enum: true = 'Acceptance (passes only if approved)', false = 'Rejection (passes unless rejected)'.

findings.title: proposeWithSettings shows threshold and majority as '7500bps', where a percentage would be easier to read.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: thresholdConditionBIPS and majorityConditionBIPS use format unit, base bps; case 3 shows '7500bps' and '5000bps'.
findings.fix: Use unit with base '%' and decimals 2 (75%), and drop '(bps)' from the labels.

findings.title: proposeWithSettings has no interpolatedIntent and the intent does not say the proposal uses custom voting rules.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json proposeWithSettings: intent 'create proposal', no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Use intent 'create proposal with custom settings' and an interpolatedIntent naming the start date and the period.

findings.title: proposeWithSettings has no test with accept=false, the case whose meaning is reversed.
findings.evidence: cases/3.json: accept = 1 is the only case for this selector.
